class HungarianMatch:
    MAXN = 2000

    def __init__(self):
        self.totalMatches = 0
        self.matchPartner = [-1] * self.MAXN
        self.reversePartner = [-1] * self.MAXN
        self.used = [0] * self.MAXN

    def findMaxMatching(self, n, adj):
        self.totalMatches = 0
        self.matchPartner = [-1] * self.MAXN
        self.reversePartner = [-1] * self.MAXN
        for i in range(n):
            self.used = [0] * self.MAXN
            if self.tryMatch(i, adj):
                self.totalMatches += 1
        return self.totalMatches

    def tryMatch(self, u, adj):
        for v in adj[u]:
            if not self.used[v]:
                self.used[v] = 1
                if self.reversePartner[v] < 0 or self.tryMatch(self.reversePartner[v], adj):
                    self.matchPartner[u] = v
                    self.reversePartner[v] = u
                    return True
        return False
